title: 楓の向こうで · Beyond the Maples
reviewStatus: Cross-checked native reference, large-v3 full/stem VAD and no-VAD, focused windows, and independent MOSS-Music transcription; no human listening sign-off
timingStatus: Selected-render ASR word anchors, approximate within-word subdivision; companion highlights are line-relative
notes: The unsung 寒くない line and missing また are not restored. 街 replaces the planned 楓 in both choruses because every independent pass recognizes machi, not kaede. 出してまう retains the sung contraction. The ending repeats 次に会えたら. The short VAD-only お土産 duplicate is rejected. Nonlexical instrumental sound is not lyric data.

lines.en: A photograph arrives from Canada
lines.zh-Hans: 加拿大寄来你的照片

lines.en: You smile through the red leaves
lines.zh-Hans: 红叶映着你的笑颜

lines.en: Here, the night is already deep
lines.zh-Hans: 我这里早已是深夜

lines.en: There, the morning is still blue
lines.zh-Hans: 你那里仍是澄蓝的清晨

replacements.reason: Full-mix and focused no-VAD both recover kaete; reference and sentence context agree.

lines.ja: 楽しんでねに変えてみる
lines.en: I change my message to: have a lovely time
lines.zh-Hans: 把想说的话改成玩得开心

lines.en: That distant city, through your eyes

lines.en: Seeing such happiness on your face

lines.ja: 寂しいなんて言えなくて

lines.zh-Hans: 便说不出口我有多寂寞

lines.ja: 会いたいな会いたいな
lines.en: I miss you, how I miss you
lines.zh-Hans: 好想见你好想见你

lines.en: When the city sways in the wind

lines.en: I hope you are smiling too
lines.zh-Hans: 愿你也正微笑着

lines.en: Do not hurry your way home
lines.zh-Hans: 回来的路不必太匆忙

lines.ja: まだ知らない景色を見て
lines.en: See the places still unknown to you
lines.zh-Hans: 去看看还未见过的风景

lines.ja: 寂しさはここに置いて
lines.en: Leave the loneliness here with me

lines.en: Bring your stories home as souvenirs

lines.en: For coffee meant for only one

replacements.reason: MOSS independently hears dashite mau. Keep the sung colloquial contraction, not the unrelated verb dance or an invented missing shi.

lines.en: On the night you come back home
